safety_health_committee_001.evidence: Schools have a variety of teams that focus on school and student improvement. These teams include grade-level teams, subject or content area teams, committees such as safety or discipline committees

safety_student_discipline_003.evidence: Each school shall annually develop and adopt a local school discipline policy with the involvement of all school community stakeholders and in accordance with the existing MCPS policy on Student Rights and Responsibilities. All members of the faculty and administration must be consulted about the development of the policy

safety_remove_student_004.evidence: When a student’s behavior seriously disrupts the instructional program to the detriment of other students, a unit member shall have the right to temporarily remove that student from class.
